item.description: Oath-breaker: Eurmenes #1732 the Oath-breaker did not keep faith with Xenmachos #6514 the Blood-handed. There is a curse now on every Leaf of Eurmenes #1732 the Oath-breaker's line, as on Glaucus' house, of which nothing remains. Eurmenes is of a cursed line.
